title: Talent Operations Specialist
description:
About Turing

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems. Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. For enterprises, Turing builds proprietary intelligence systems that integrate AI into mission-critical workflows, unlock transformative outcomes, and drive lasting competitive advantage.

Recognized by Forbes, The Information, and Fast Company among the world’s top innovators, Turing’s leadership team includes AI technologists from Meta, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, McKinsey, Bain, Stanford, Caltech, and MIT. Learn more at

Role Summary

This role's primary responsibility will be to carry on talents through the selection process, by executing all the operational steps involved. Those might involve scheduling interviews, speaking and negotiating with candidates, reporting collected information and statuses, and interacting with internal stakeholders.

Besides the tasks execution the person in this role will also be pushed to think and work under the scalability mindset, delivering operational efficiency on the ground. The ideal candidate should be able to execute while challenging the status quo, automatizing repeatable processes, streamlining processes, optimizing cross-functional handoffs, reducing SLAs and improving talents’ experience.

Core Responsibilities

  • Operational Execution : Manage all candidate-related operational steps, including communication via email, WhatsApp, and phone; scheduling technical and client interviews; conducting non-technical interviews; coordinating availability; negotiating rates; and ensuring smooth onboarding transitions.
  • Stakeholder Communication : Provide clear, timely updates and handoffs through shared documents, chat channels, and meetings while keeping candidates informed, engaged, and aware of next steps and feedback throughout the process.
  • Data Analysis & Reporting : Collect, clean, and analyze operational data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities; monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and service-level agreements (SLAs) to maintain high operational standards.
  • Process Optimization : Continuously evaluate and refine workflows to improve scalability and candidate experience, develop and document standard operating procedures (SOPs), and implement automation solutions to enhance efficiency.
  • Bandwidth & Pipeline Management : Manage large candidate pipelines daily by effectively prioritizing tasks, coordinating with stakeholders, and maintaining consistent productivity and quality under high-volume conditions.
  • Organization & Documentation : Maintain structured, accurate, and up-to-date spreadsheets, trackers, and operational documentation to ensure data integrity and transparency across all processes.
  • Compliance & Risk Management : Adhere to company policies, process playbooks, and quality standards, while supporting audits and reporting efforts to ensure full compliance with organizational and industry regulations.
  • Adaptability & Collaboration : Operate effectively in dynamic, fast-paced environments by switching contexts seamlessly, collaborating across global time zones, and maintaining accountability and clear communication to meet deadlines.

Qualifications

  • Education : Bachelor’s degree in, Business Administration, Data Analytics, Engineering, Human Resources or a related field.
  • Experience : 3–6 years at Operations within digital business, or Talent Operations, People Operations, Recruiting Operations, at a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
  • Analytical Skills : Strong proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets (pivot tables, formulas, dashboards); ability to manage databases and process them into reports and insights.
  • Communication : Excellent written and verbal communication skills (English), with the ability to convey complex information clearly to both candidates and internal stakeholders.
  • Organization & Prioritization : Proven ability to manage multiple tasks, stakeholders, and competing priorities while maintaining high attention to detail.
  • Process Orientation : Demonstrated ability to identify inefficiencies, document workflows, and implement process improvements or automation initiatives.
  • Stakeholder Management : Skilled at partnering with recruiters, hiring managers, and cross-functional teams to deliver timely and accurate operational support.
  • Adaptability : Comfortable working across global time zones, shifting priorities, and high-volume pipelines in a dynamic, scaling environment.

Values

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed : We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward : We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

Advantages of joining Turing

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.

Responsibilities

  • Drive resolution of customer issues, act as a customer advocate, and maintain happy and satisfied customers
  • Follow the client's customer support process and meet established service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Triage support requests by conducting a first-level investigation of technical product issues
  • Provide continuous and timely updates on issue resolution status to customers and key internal stakeholders
  • Engage with the Engineering team to ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to SLAs and escalate when necessary to meet those goals

Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product
  • Passion for providing technical support to customers and helping them gain success using client products

title: Preschool Teaching Assistant (maternity cover)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW: 

The Teaching Assistant at EAC is dedicated to the school’s mission, vision, and core values, demonstrating respect for diverse cultures and learners. Teaching Assistants (TAs) play an essential role in supporting high-quality, inquiry-based international education within the Montessori and IB Primary Years Programme (PYP). Assigned to one classroom or one subject area for the school year, Teaching Assistants collaborate closely with the Specialist, Homeroom, and/or Brazilian Studies teacher to support student learning, provide individualized assistance, and foster an environment of care and belonging.

Teaching Assistants contribute to planning, instruction, assessment, and supervision, ensuring students are safe, engaged, and supported academically, socially, and emotionally. As active members of the Professional Learning Community, they participate in professional development and continuous reflection to enhance their effectiveness in supporting student growth.

ORGANIZATIONAL RESULTS:

Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and caring learning environment aligned with EAC’s mission and values.

Support the effective delivery of the school curriculum and programs by reinforcing learning and differentiated instruction.

Foster student well-being, independence, and positive relationships within the classroom and broader school community.

Model professionalism, collaboration, and ethical conduct in alignment with school policies and expectations.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:

Instructional Support and Student Learning

Collaborate with the classroom teacher to plan and deliver structured learning experiences for the whole class, small groups, and individual students.

Support students in understanding and reinforcing concepts introduced by the teacher, promoting independence and confidence in learning.

Prepare and organize resources, adapting materials and strategies to meet diverse student needs and cultural backgrounds.

Assist in providing formative feedback and collecting academic and behavioral data as directed by the teacher.

Participate in meetings and conferences, sharing relevant insights on student learning and providing translation or language support, when needed.

Student Care and Learning Environment

Help establish and maintain a positive, proactive, and fair classroom environment that promotes respect and self-management.

Supervise and support students to ensure safety and engagement during class and non-class times (breaks, lunch, transitions, etc.).

Apply logical and natural consequences in alignment with teacher expectations and school guidelines.

Communicate concerns about student well-being or behavior to the classroom teacher promptly and appropriately.

Operational and School Support

Assist in daily classroom routines including attendance, organization, and resource management.

Provide administrative support such as photocopying, filing, and preparing materials.

Request, organize, distribute materials and resources for the classroom or department as needed.

Supervise students during assigned duties (e.g., car pickup, lunch, recess) and assist during school trips and events.

Substitute for the classroom teacher as needed and ensure continuity of learning and care.

Support translation and communication between school and families when necessary, ensuring the teacher remains the primary point of contact.

Support and guide new Teaching Assistants as needed. 

Professional Conduct and Growth

Model professionalism, punctuality, confidentiality, and responsible communication, including social media conduct.

Follow EAC policies, procedures, and safeguarding expectations as outlined in the Faculty/Staff Handbook.

Engage in professional development opportunities and participate in the Teaching Assistant Professional Growth and Evaluation process.

Collaborate positively with colleagues, offering support to new teaching assistants and contributing to a culture of collegiality and continuous improvement.

Additional Responsibilities

Engages in regular meetings and professional learning as part of the school’s commitment to continuous growth and collaboration.

Engage in the behavioral norms and expectations of the school. 

Support student toileting needs, as per school norms, as assigned.

Follow the EAC Safeguarding Guide.

Working Conditions

Walk on paths and rough terrain

Lifting backpacks and school materials

Other duties, as assigned.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS:

  • Degree in Pedagogy, preferred
  • Five years experience working with children, preferred
  • PYP and inquiry-based teaching and learning experience (preferred)
  • English level required: B2 or above
  • Portuguese level required: B2 or above

Other Skills (Desirable):

  • Proven capacity to build relationships of trust and respect
  • Proven capacity and confidence working within a collaborative, team-oriented environment
  • Strong written, verbal, and digital communication skills
  • Strong professional organization skills

Child Safeguarding

Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.

EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion

EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

The ideal candidate will combine data engineering skills with cloud automation and DevOps practices to ensure performance, reliability, and scalability in Azure.

This role is hybrid based in Sao Paulo on a contractual-basis, full-time hours, projected to be a year long, and for a global IT consulting firm.

  • Build and maintain data and cloud infrastructure in Microsoft Azure.
  • Develop and manage CI/CD pipelines for data and application deployments.
  • Support SQL databases and BI tools (SSIS, SSRS, SSAS).
  • Automate cloud provisioning using Terraform, ARM templates, and scripting (Python, PowerShell).
  • Manage and monitor resources in Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and other Azure services.
  • Implement and maintain alerting and monitoring (Azure Monitor, Grafana).
  • Ensure security, performance, and cost optimization of cloud environments.
  • Collaborate with developers and business teams to align DevOps and data practices with business needs.

Required Skills & Experience:

  • 8–10+ years of IT experience with strong Azure Cloud and DevOps background.
  • Hands-on experience with AKS , VMs, networking, and Azure databases.
  • Strong SQL and data integration experience (SSIS/SSRS/SSAS) OR similar BI reporting tools .
  • Proficiency in Python and PowerShell scripting.
  • Experience with Terraform , Azure DevOps , or similar CI/CD tools.
  • Knowledge of containerization ( Docker/Kubernetes ) and infrastructure automation.
  • Familiar with cloud security and disaster recovery practices.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure DevOps Engineer Expert or Azure Solutions Architect.
  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) is a plus.
  • Experience in the retail energy (power & gas) industry is an advantage.

Brian Scott

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
Van Hessen is one of the leading global players in the sourcing, processing and distribution of natural casings, meat products and pharmaceuticals. We process animal by-products from slaughterhouses into high-quality food materials and raw materials for the pharmaceutical industry. Our products are 100% natural and, due to the knowledge and skills of our employees, of a very high and consistent quality. We strive to outdo ourselves every day.

About the role

Manage and coordinate the company's human resources function across subfunctions, such as recruitment, training and talent development, compensation and benefits, organization development, and employee relations, to meet company’s business requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the formation of one or more elements of functional strategy through specialist expertise and insights, to ensure that the strategy meets business needs.
  • Explore and develop a detailed understanding of external developments or emerging issues and evaluate their potential impact on, or usefulness to, the organization.
  • Deliver complex analyses of HR data; identify key trends and contribute to the creation of HR insights that enable the diagnosis of business issues, enhancement of employee engagement, and/or improvement of business performance.
  • Implement HR frameworks and tools for recruitment, performance management, development, career and succession planning, compensation and benefits, diversity, employee onboarding and offboarding, and retention of talent, within an area of expertise, to meet business or institution needs and enable the attraction, development, and retention of talent at a sustainable cost. Ensure compliance with specified design principles, internal policies, and external legal requirements.
  • Provide specialist advice on the interpretation and application of policies and procedures, resolving queries and issues and referring very complex or contentious issues to others.
  • Communicate the local action plan; explain how this relates to the function's strategy and action plan and to the broader organization's mission and vision; motivate people to achieve local business goals.
  • Help develop procedures for an area of the organization and monitor their implementation.
  • Deliver a budget for an area of the organization or conduct complex analyses on budget progress in other areas of the organization.
  • Contribute to the development and testing of HR data collection forms or questionnaires in a specific area of expertise to ensure the collection of relevant data in line with defined requirements.
  • Use the organization's formal development framework to identify the team's individual development needs. Plan and implement actions to build their capabilities. Provide training or coaching to others throughout the organization in own area of expertise to enable others to improve performance and fulfill personal potential.
  • Develop and propose own performance objectives; take appropriate actions to ensure achievement of agreed objectives, using the organization's performance management systems to improve personal performance. Or manage and report on team performance; set appropriate performance objectives for direct reports or project/account team members and hold people accountable for achieving them, taking appropriate corrective action where necessary to ensure the achievement of team/personal objectives.
  • Manage workstreams or small projects within a transformational change program, ensuring integration with related projects; use structured change management methodologies to build acceptance of change and embed desired culture and behaviours.

About you

  • Further/higher education in human resources or business discipline, with 5-8 years prior experience in HR role.
  • Experience working within a manufacturing organisation would be advantageous.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to exercise good judgement
  • A team player with a professional and flexible approach to work.
  • Innovative thinking with a passion to make a difference within the HR team and wider business.
  • Proficiency in English, Portuguese and Spanish is essential for this role.
  • A solid understanding of current employment law and HR best practice.
  • Flexible with travelling between our four sites (Paraguay, Brazil, Argentina and Chile) is required.

description:

Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia, referência na América Latina.   • Comunicação excepcional: Habilidade oral e escrita para interações via telefone, WhatsApp e e-mail.
  • Perfil organizado e resiliente: Energia, senso de dono e capacidade de se adaptar a um ambiente dinâmico.
  • Habilidade de negociação e persuasão: Capacidade de argumentar e buscar resultados acima da média, sempre com foco no cliente.
  • Relacionamento interpessoal: Facilidade em criar conexões significativas e construir parcerias de longo prazo.
  • Morar na cidade e ter como se locomover: Ser residente da cidade de Cáceres - MT e possuir mobilidade para realizar deslocamentos com facilidade.

Sobre Nós

No iFood, acreditamos na força da diversidade para gerar #Inovação e alcançar #Resultados incríveis. Por isso, valorizamos candidatos independentemente de deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar ou estética. Temos grupos compostos por foodlovers voluntários, onde falamos sobre Raça, Gênero, LGBTQI+ e PcD. Queremos ser a empresa onde as pessoas escolham se desenvolver e realizar seus sonhos. #AllTogether.

Conheça nossas iniciativas | Institucional iFood

Você Tem Fome de Quê?

Temos fome de inovação e resultados. Sempre buscamos fazer o nosso melhor, pensando "fora da caixa" e agindo com agilidade e responsabilidade. Valorizamos a diversidade, o conhecimento e o compartilhamento em um ambiente dinâmico e versátil. O ingrediente especial da nossa receita? As pessoas. Vem fazer parte disso!

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
About the Role and Reponsabilities:

In this role you will have the chance to build large additions to our platform ecosystem, contributing to an infrastructure that centralizes our ETL and streaming infrastructure, enables experimentation and data development, and powers algorithm development. You will design and build scalable engineering solutions to solve business and data problems.

title: Director of Sales LATAM
description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of science video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Universidade de São Paulo (USP), Tecnológico de Monterrey (ITESM), Universidad Nacional Autónoma de México (UNAM) and Universidad de los Andes. As a rapidly growing company with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India, servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.

The Role

We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented professional to join our team as Director of Sales. In this key role, you will lead a team of Account Executives, drive growth, and contribute to JoVE’s ongoing success in the Latin America market.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the regional sales team to consistently meet & exceed assigned revenue targets in the LATAM region.
  • Provide strategic leadership and oversight of the sales team’s activities, driving new business acquisition and expanding existing accounts.
  • Recruit, mentor, and develop sales talent to grow and expand the reach of JoVE’s extensive library of STEM video titles.
  • Define, implement, and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for the sales team, regularly assessing progress and making adjustments to ensure success.
  • Analyze buyer and influencer motivations, competitive dynamics, and the sales cycle to prioritize and refine sales strategies.
  • Collaborate with marketing, customer success, and other teams to ensure alignment of sales efforts with company objectives and goals.
  • Successfully plan and manage renewal projects with existing clients.

Requirements

  • A Bachelor’s degree.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience leading sales teams in Higher Education publishing, EdTech, or STEM publishing industries.
  • 10+ years of experience in sales, preferably in the Higher Education sector.
  • Proven track record of success in sales leadership roles.
  • Target-oriented and willing to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Why Join JoVE?

  • A competitive compensation package including unlimited commissions on your sales
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

title: Gerente de transportes
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Gerente de Transportes Outbound para uma empresa localizada em Contagem/MG.

Seu perfil corresponde ao da vaga descrita abaixo? Então, faça sua candidatura!

Objetivo da posição:

A companhia está em um momento estratégico de transformação logística — com foco na migração de operações spot para contratos com transportadoras preferenciais, na implementação de uma torre de controle digital e na padronização das rotinas dos Centros de Distribuição.

O grande objetivo dessa jornada é elevar o nível de serviço ao cliente, otimizar custos e impulsionar a produtividade em toda a cadeia logística.

Buscamos um(a) profissional para liderar essa operação, assumindo a gestão de toda a logística de transportes e de quatro Centros de Distribuição terceirizados, com uma equipe de 20 pessoas e reporte direto à Diretoria de Supply Chain.

Entre as principais responsabilidades, estão: gerenciar a distribuição nacional de produtos acabados, além de conduzir negociações e renegociações com transportadoras e operadores logísticos estratégicos.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Liderar e gerenciar todo o processo de logística de transportes outbound;
  • Implementar torre de controle digital;
  • Gerir centros de distribuição;
  • Estruturar o modelo de logística reversa;
  • Contratar e gerenciar operadores logísticos;
  • Automatizar as rotinas administrativas e criar dashboards para gestão à vista;
  • Gerenciar ricos junto à ANTT e aos órgãos reguladores;
  • Estruturar o modelo de roteirização e ocupação.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia;
  • Experiência com logística de cargas pesadas e produtos acabados de grande porte;
  • Experiência consolidada em gestão de transporte, outbound, contratação de fretes, gestão de SLAs e performance de transportadoras;
  • Experiência com torre de controle e roteirização;
  • Experiência com gestão de CDs terceirizados;
  • Experiência em reversa (clientes e retornáveis) ou claro plano para estruturá-la;
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado;
  • Disponibilidade/mobilidade para atuar em Contagem/MG.

Sobre a FESA Group:

Fundada em 1995, a FESA Group é uma empresa brasileira que apoia organizações em toda a jornada estratégica de gestão de pessoas: do recrutamento executivo ao desenvolvimento de lideranças e à transformação cultural. Referência em seu setor de atuação, combina inteligência de mercado, especialização setorial e tecnologia, tendo a felicidade corporativa como parte essencial do seu DNA.

Seu portfólio integrado oferece soluções sob medida para aquisição, desenvolvimento, sucessão e retenção de talentos, sempre com foco no cliente e na entrega de resultados que geram impacto real nos negócios e na vida das pessoas. Mais do que autoridade nos setores em que atua — como Agronegócio, Indústria, Energia e Infraestrutura, Mercado Financeiro e Varejo —, conta com consultores especialistas preparados para criar conexões humanas que impulsionam crescimento e transformação.

Com presença em todo o Brasil por meio de escritórios regionais e atuação internacional via IIC Partners, presente em mais de 30 países, a FESA Group alia alcance global à expertise local. No campo social, o Instituto FESA C.R.O.M.A promove programas de voluntariado voltados à educação e qualificação profissional de jovens em situação de vulnerabilidade, reforçando seu compromisso com uma sociedade mais inclusiva e sustentável.

title: Sr. Data Analytics Engineer
description:
About Credix  

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job We are looking for someone to join Credix as a a Senior Analytics Engineer. You will take ownership of structuring our data analytics platform and analytics use-cases. You love to tackle big problems and break them down into smaller pieces. You will build an analytics platform that features reliable, timely and understandable metrics in a slice-and-dice format to empower other teams to make better decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain dbt models and reliable datasets that power analytics, experiments, and decision-making across the company.
  • Define and act upon standards for metrics, data modeling practices, and documentation.
  • Oversee the full analytics lifecycle, from transforming raw to delivering insights in BI platforms (e.g. Hex).
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering to ensure analytics pipelines meet high standards of quality, observability and testing.
  • Enable self-service analytics by creating semantic layers and reusable data assets that let teams create insights independently.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related technical data role.
  • Deep expertise with SQL and dbt, including modular modeling, documentation, and testing.
  • Proven track record of building source-of-truth data models that support product use cases.
  • Experience with cloud data warehouses (BigQuery), semantic layers (dbt), version control (Git), and visualization tools (Hex).
  • Experience in a (credit) FinTech is a must.
  • Manager of one: structuring, and executing upon the analytics roadmap.
  • Analytical and system-oriented mindset with a strong problem-solving ability to handle complex data challenges.
  • Proactive, clear and concise communication both in Portuguese and English, ensuring alignment with cross-functional teams.
  • Anticipate business metrics needs and structure the analytics layer to ensure scalability and reusability across the entire company.
  • High attention to detail and a perfectionist approach, especially in maintaining metrics quality and integrity.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, startup environment.
  • Genuine interest/passion for disrupting the B2B credit market in Brazil by using data.
  • Collaborative mindset, working effectively with diverse stakeholders.

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

- A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies

- Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.

- Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.

- Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate

- Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

description:

Essa posição tem papel estratégico na integração entre indústria, fornecedores e revendedores, com foco em aumentar as vendas, ampliar a rede de revenda de lubrificantes Mobil e fortalecer o posicionamento da marca no canal de conveniência. Será também responsável por implementar estratégias comerciais e operacionais que assegurem o crescimento sustentável do negócio e a diferenciação competitiva das franquias no mercado.

Principais Responsabilidades

· Estruturar e aprimorar a oferta de valor das franquias, com foco em crescimento sustentável e aumento de rentabilidade.

· Desenvolver planogramas e padrões operacionais para potencializar o giro das principais categorias.

· Conduzir o reposicionamento comercial das lojas de conveniência, alinhado à estratégia de negócio.

· Atuar como elo estratégico entre franqueados, indústria e parceiros, fortalecendo negociações e parcerias comerciais.

· Expandir a rede de postos revendedores de lubrificantes Mobil, implementando ações de venda consultiva e aumento de volume.

· Aumentar as vendas de lubrificantes por meio de estratégias de canal, campanhas e melhoria da execução no ponto de venda.

· Liderar o processo de transformação das lojas para novos formatos, como o modelo “Esquina” .

· Coordenar e desenvolver a equipe de consultores de franquias, promovendo maturidade e alta performance.

· Garantir integração com áreas corporativas (Trade Marketing, Operações e Comercial) e alinhamento com metas de expansão.

· Monitorar indicadores de performance e resultados financeiros, atuando com visão analítica e foco em resultados.

title: Masters / PHD In Science
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.

About the Role:

At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.

We are seeking a Masters / PHD In Science with exceptional writing and analytical skills to join our AI/ML data team. In this role, you will help train advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) by producing, curating, and reviewing high-quality educational and technical mathematics content. Your expertise will directly shape the way AI systems understand, explain, and reason about fundamental and advanced mathematical concepts.

Key Responsibilities:

Create high-quality, accurate, and pedagogically sound content in mathematics, including:

  • Conceptual explanations
  • Problem sets and solutions
  • Theoretical summaries and derivations
  • Research abstracts and technical writing

Collaborate with AI researchers and engineers to:

  • Review and refine mathematics-related model outputs
  • Identify and fill conceptual gaps in LLM training data
  • Build datasets across various mathematics domains (e.g., Algebra, Calculus, Geometry, Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Number Theory, Discrete Math, etc.)
  • Provide feedback to improve LLM performance in reasoning, solving, and communicating mathematical content

Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master's or PhD in Mathematics or a closely related discipline (MS with exceptional experience may be considered)
  • Strong background in theoretical and/or applied mathematics
  • Excellent technical and academic writing skills

As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

*The assessment is mandatory & non-billable*

Sobre a Agropalma

A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. Essa lógica também se aplica à nossa cultura: temos um DNA inovador que instiga todo o nosso time a se reinventar constantemente. Estamos com uma nova oportunidade para o time de tecnologia. O Agilista é um agente de transformação que conecta estratégia, execução e cultura ágil. No BS2, esse papel garante que as iniciativas digitais estejam alinhadas ao plano estratégico, promovendo governança robusta, gestão eficiente do portfólio e evolução contínua do modelo operacional.

  • Atuar com o Product Owners e equipes, garantindo gestão eficaz do backlog e priorização para a entrega de resultados esperado.
  • Garantir a execução das cerimônias ágeis no time (Refinamento técnico, Daily, Planning, Review, Retrospective) e promover a comunicação transparente.
  • Garantir a execução das cerimônias táticas (Tribe Report e Portfólio Meeting) e promover a comunicação transparente aos stakeholders.
  • Apoiar na definição de métricas de performance e indicadores de valor para monitorar evolução dos processos.
  • Fomentar a cultura ágil organizacional, incentivando colaboração e aprendizado contínuo.
  • Identificar gargalos no fluxo de trabalho e propor melhorias para aumentar a velocidade e qualidade das entregas.
  • Garantir uma boa gestão de portfólio, alinhando iniciativas estratégicas aos objetivos do negócio, priorizando demandas e monitorando capacidade das squads.
  • Manter e evoluir o modelo operacional ágil, assegurando governança, padrões e práticas consistentes entre times e áreas, além de promover ajustes conforme necessidades do negócio.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Ensino superior completo em Tecnologia, Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação, especializações e MBA será um diferencial.
  • Experiência como Agilista, Scrum Master, Agile Coach ou PO em ambientes digitais ou financeiros.
  • Conhecimentos em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, Lean Inception, SAFe)
  • Habilidades com ferramentas de gestão (Jira, Azure DevOps e Power BI) e de Inteligência Artificial
  • Vivência com gestão de portfólio e governança ágil
  • Habilidades de comunicação clara, empatia, liderança servidora, negociação e resolução de conflitos.

title: Masters / PHD In Physics
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.

About the Role:

At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.

We are seeking a Masters / PHD In Physics with exceptional writing and analytical skills to join our AI/ML data team. In this role, you will help train advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) by producing, curating, and reviewing high-quality educational and technical mathematics content. Your expertise will directly shape the way AI systems understand, explain, and reason about fundamental and advanced mathematical concepts.

Key Responsibilities:

Create high-quality, accurate, and pedagogically sound content in mathematics, including:

  • Conceptual explanations
  • Problem sets and solutions
  • Theoretical summaries and derivations
  • Research abstracts and technical writing

Collaborate with AI researchers and engineers to:

  • Review and refine mathematics-related model outputs
  • Identify and fill conceptual gaps in LLM training data
  • Build datasets across various mathematics domains (e.g., Algebra, Calculus, Geometry, Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Number Theory, Discrete Math, etc.)
  • Provide feedback to improve LLM performance in reasoning, solving, and communicating mathematical content

Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master's or PhD in Mathematics or a closely related discipline (MS with exceptional experience may be considered)
  • Strong background in theoretical and/or applied mathematics
  • Excellent technical and academic writing skills

As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

*The assessment is mandatory & non-billable*

title: Analista Gestão de Pessoas Sr.
description:
Sobre a vaga

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Objetivo do cargo:

Atrair, identificar e selecionar os melhores talentos para atender às demandas operacionais e estratégicas da Diretoria de Logística, atuando de forma alinhada às políticas de Recursos Humanos e às diretrizes organizacionais, garantindo a eficiência dos processos seletivos e contribuindo para a formação de equipes qualificadas e alinhadas à cultura da empresa.

Requisitos do Cargo

Formação:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Psicologia, Economia ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência:

  • Vivência sólida na área de Atração e Seleção.
  • Experiência comprovada em técnicas de entrevista por competência e ferramentas de avaliação comportamental.
  • Conhecimento da legislação trabalhista e normas de inclusão (como a Lei de cotas)

REDX is a SaaS company that builds prospecting software to help real estate agents and teams grow their business. Our platform offers high-quality lead data, productivity tools.   • Experience working in cross-functional teams and mentoring junior engineers

What You'll Get

  • Seguir rigorosamente as normas e procedimentos de segurança (NR-10 e NR-35) e os padrões de qualidade da empresa.

title: Data Analyst (Sales Focus)
description:
About YipitData:

YipitData is the market-leading data and analytics firm. We analyze billions of data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights across industries, including consumer brands, technology, software, and healthcare.

Our insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data that many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on. We raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B, further accelerating our growth and market impact.

We have been recognized multiple times as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces. As a fast-growing company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners, YipitData is driven by a people-first culture rooted in mastery, ownership, and transparency.

With offices in New York, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore, we continue to expand our reach and impact across global markets.

Why You Should Apply NOW:

  • The Data Feeds team manages the data feeds business at YipitData. We partner with systematic and quantamental investment firms by providing access to alternative data for investment analytics and model development.
  • Become part of a growing team where your ideas and collaboration will have a direct impact on how we deliver value to top-tier investment firms.

About The Role:

YipitData seeks a proactive, analytically minded Sales Engineer with +2 years of experience to join our dynamic team. This role will directly influence the growth of our data feed revenue. As a Sales Engineer, you will provide our clients with operational and quantitative development support , enabling them to utilize and evaluate YipitData’s data feeds effectively.

We expect East Coast work hours.

As Our Sales Engineer, You Will:

  • Provide operational support during client onboarding, with a strong focus on the setup, configuration, and integration of complex data feeds (40% daily focus).
  • Partner closely with Sales to drive product adoption by delivering demonstrations, analyses, and explanations of complex data feeds to clients.
  • Address client queries and maintain strong relationships by ensuring our data solutions align closely with clients’ investment strategies.
  • Develop quantitative documentation, scripts, and use-case examples to facilitate client evaluations, integrations, and ongoing data usage (60% daily focus).
  • Collaborate with Product to improve product features based on client feedback.

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline or finance-related field.
  • Experience in financial markets (Nice to have) ; excellent client-facing communication skills.
  • Experience working with US clients is highly preferred
  • Proficiency in Python (preferred), SQL, Databricks (preferred), Jupyter, and AWS (Knowledge focused on answering clients’ questions).

What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work

Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Analista de PR Sênior
description:
Local: São Paulo/SP

Área: Marketing & Growth | Branding

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Sênior de PR que será responsável por implementar e garantir a execução das estratégias de Relações Públicas da Serena, contribuindo para o fortalecimento da reputação institucional e para o reconhecimento da marca.

Essa posição tem papel estratégico na construção de credibilidade, visibilidade e influência da Serena junto à imprensa, stakeholders e formadores de opinião, traduzindo o propósito da marca em narrativas consistentes, relevantes e inspiradoras.

⚙️ Principais Responsabilidades

  • Implementar e garantir a execução das estratégias de PR e comunicação externa alinhadas ao posicionamento institucional e aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa;
  • Assegurar consistência e coerência das mensagens em todos os canais e interlocuções externas;
  • Produzir, revisar e aprimorar materiais institucionais, como press releases, notas, artigos de opinião, Q&As e briefings de porta-vozes;
  • Mapear oportunidades de exposição na mídia e fortalecer o relacionamento com jornalistas e veículos estratégicos dos segmentos de energia, negócios e inovação;
  • Atuar em sinergia com Branding, Comunicação e Marketing para ampliar a presença da Serena em pautas estratégicas, como mercado livre de energia, transição energética e inovação;
  • Utilizar ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial e análise de dados para mensurar performance, gerar insights e orientar decisões baseadas em reputação e impacto;
  • Preparar e apoiar porta-vozes em entrevistas, eventos e oportunidades de fala, garantindo alinhamento de discurso e coerência institucional;
  • Elaborar relatórios analíticos de resultados, com foco em impacto de marca, alcance, percepção e evolução da reputação;
  • Fazer a gestão dos fornecedores, principalmente a assessoria de imprensa.

Requisitos Técnicos / Hard Skills

  • Formação superior em Jornalismo, Relações Públicas, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente (escrita, leitura e conversação);
  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em PR ou Comunicação Externa, preferencialmente em empresas de médio ou grande porte;
  • Vivência sólida em relacionamento com imprensa, gestão de pautas e comunicação corporativa;
  • Excelente domínio de escrita jornalística e storytelling institucional;
  • Capacidade de analisar métricas e resultados de PR, traduzindo dados em recomendações estratégicas;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas e soluções de IA aplicadas à comunicação (monitoramento, clipping inteligente, relatórios automatizados).

Soft Skills

  • Excelente relacionamento interpessoal e capacidade de articulação com diferentes públicos;
  • Perfil proativo, autônomo e colaborativo, com alto senso de responsabilidade;
  • Visão estratégica e senso de dono sobre as entregas;
  • Clareza, objetividade e empatia na comunicação;
  • Organização, atenção aos detalhes e foco em resultados;
  • Curiosidade e interesse genuíno em aprender sobre o setor de energia e suas transformações.

Diferenciais

  • Afinidade com temas de tecnologia, inovação e mercado livre de energia;
  • Experiência prévia em empresas do setor de energia ou segmentos regulados;
  • Histórico de posicionamento de marca corporativa e relacionamento com imprensa especializada;
  • Cases comprovados de PR com impacto positivo em reputação e reconhecimento de marca.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Operação - CD
description:
Prazer, Grupo SBF! Para nós, esporte é mais que só a prática: é movimento. Ele tem o poder de mover as pessoas pelo exercício, pela paixão pelo time do coração, pela diversão de uma aula de dança, pela força de marcas icônicas. Por vermos a potência do esporte em todas as suas expressões, trabalhamos juntos com garra e energia para construir o primeiro ecossistema de esporte do mundo, reunindo diversas possibilidades para que as pessoas sejam envolvidas e impactadas pelo poder de se movimentar. Quando você pensar em esporte, pode ter certeza: o Grupo SBF estará ali. Seja por meio das lojas e do e-commerce da Centauro, a maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina; da Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil, da FitDance, da OneFan e da X3M, aqui o movimento não para. Praticante ou entusiasta, fã ou apaixonado: o Grupo SBF é pra você. Somos saudavelmente inconformados, fazedores e convictos da importância de levar o movimento para cada vez mais gente. Se você se move por esporte, ou é movido por ele, temos um convite: que tal também trabalhar por ele? Ficou interessado(a)? Vem saber mais!

Sobre a posição no jogo:

Como Pessoa Coordenadora de Operação - CD, você entrará em campo, com as seguintes atividades:

  • Garantir que todos os seus liderados estejam devidamente preparados para executar suas rotinas de trabalho, com insumos, equipamentos, EPIS e conhecimento dos processos.
  • Treinar sua Equipe;
  • Elaborar e multiplicar LPP;
  • Garantir a aplicação do Programa 5S em sua área;
  • Garantir que os quadros de gestão estejam atualizados;
  • Propor melhorias nos processos produtivos que busquem a redução de custos operacionais, a qualidade nos serviços e a segurança dos liderados;
  • Analisar e propor soluções para os desvios de produção, aplicando ferramentas como o A3, PDCA, Kaizen e outros;
  • Garantir que todos os KPIs da área sejam atendidos conforme o acordado com a gestão do CD, como SLA CD LF, SLA Digital, OTIF e etc.
  • Desenvolver sua equipe nos valores da Centauro, Cliente no Centro do Negócio;
  • Cuidar para que todos os pedidos estejam separados corretamente, no tempo certo e na qualidade certa, seja para os clientes externos (Digital), seja para os clientes internos (LF);
  • Acompanhar a performance individual de seus liderados e dar feedbacks regulares;
  • Zelar para que os estoques dos CDs estejam corretos com os produtos alocados corretamente na quantidade e no local correto.

O que você precisa para essa posição no jogo:

  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar no terceiro turno, das 22:20 as 6h de domingo a sexta-feira.
  • Formação Acadêmica: Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Logística, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável conhecimento em Gestão de Pessoas e Ferramentas da Qualidade (PDCA, Kaizen, A3, entre outras).
  • Experiência Experiência prévia em operações logísticas, preferencialmente em Centros de Distribuição ou Armazéns.
  • Vivência em liderança de equipes operacionais e desenvolvimento de pessoas.
  • Experiência com análise de indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e melhoria contínua de processos.
  • Competências Funcionais e Técnicas Planejamento e organização. Resolução de problemas e tomada de decisão.
  • Comunicação clara e eficaz, com habilidade para conduzir treinamentos e feedbacks.
  • Gestão de estoque e garantia de acuracidade.
  • Conhecimento em Segurança do Trabalho e aplicação do Programa 5S. Flexibilidade e adaptabilidade frente a mudanças e demandas do negócio.
  • Domínio de WMS, Pacote Office (Excel avançado é um diferencial) e Google Workspace.
  • Capacidade de propor soluções e otimizações para redução de custos e aumento da eficiência operacional.

title: Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Associate - Simulation
description:
Moffatt & Nichol specializes in large complex waterfront infrastructure projects and is recognized as one of the worldwide leaders in this field. We combine engineering excellence with innovative digital solutions to solve real-world infrastructure challenges. From port and terminal digital twins to cloud-based inspection tools and automated 3D reconstruction, we deliver high-impact, data-driven insights to clients across the globe. We are actively looking for a Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Associate to join our Sao Paulo office. As part of the Flexterm Group, the Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Associate will help build robust pipelines that power simulation workflows, Kafka-driven data ingestion, Databricks-based data transformation, and cloud-based delivery of inspection and 3D data to client platforms. This is a hybrid position and will require some in-office presence in our office in Sao Paulo, BR.

About Moffatt & Nichol:

Moffatt & Nichol is a leading U.S.-based global infrastructure advisor specializing in the planning and design of facilities that shape and serve our coastlines, harbors and rivers, as well as an innovator in transportation. For the 4th year in a row, Moffatt & Nichol is Ranked #1 in Engineering News-Record for Marine & Port Facilities in the U.S. Additionally, our firm consistently ranks in the Top 100 Pure Designers in the US and the Top 50 Designers in International Markets.

Moffatt & Nichol's professional staff includes engineers, planners, scientists and architects who serve our global client base from offices in Europe, North America, Latin America, and the Pacific Rim. The firm provides clients worldwide with customized service and a level of excellence that have become the firm’s hallmark in several primary practice areas – ports and harbors; coastal, environmental and water resources; urban waterfronts and marinas; transportation, bridges and rail; inspection and rehabilitation; and energy.

Duties and responsibilities:

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

Azure Cloud Infrastructure

  • Design, build, and maintain secure, scalable environments using Azure (AKS, VMs, Functions, Blob Storage, App Services, etc.)
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform or Bicep to deploy and maintain consistent cloud environments

CI/CD and Automation

  • Create automated CI/CD pipelines for data processing, simulation, and 3D asset workflows
  • Enable cross-team automation for simulation engineers, inspection groups, and digital twin platform developers

Kafka & Databricks Pipelines

  • Set up and manage Kafka-based data ingestion from external platforms.
  • Integrate with Databricks for real-time and batch processing of simulation data, crack detection outputs, and inspection datasets

Simulation & Twin Integration

  • Deploy and orchestrate compute-heavy simulation jobs in the cloud
  • Integrate simulation results into real-time digital twin systems, enabling actionable insights on equipment performance and operational planning

3D Reconstruction & Inspection Workflows

  • Automate cloud-based 3D model reconstruction from inspection datasets (e.g., point clouds, drone imagery, crack detection outputs)
  • Package and deliver reconstructed 3D models and annotated inspection results via secure client portals or custom viewers

Client-Facing Delivery & Collaboration

  • Build secure sharing mechanisms for inspection reports, simulation results, and 3D models
  • Ensure reliable, auditable delivery pipelines that meet client compliance and usability needs

Security, Monitoring, and Resilience

  • Implement best practices in cloud security, encryption, and access control
  • Monitor systems using Azure Monitor, ELK, or Prometheus/Grafana to ensure availability, scalability, and performance

Other duties:

Please note this job posting is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Required qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related engineering degree (Software or Computer Engineering)
  • 4-8 years of experience
  • Strong experience with Azure services: AKS, Blob, Functions, App Gateway, and Networking
  • Proficient with Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration at scale
  • Proficient with CI/CD tools: GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins
  • Hands-on with Kafka, including configuration, message flows, and monitoring
  • Experienced in Databricks: notebooks, pipelines, Delta Lake, and cluster management
  • Proficient in Python, Bash, or other scripting languages for automation
  • Skilled in infrastructure-as-code using Terraform or Bicep

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related engineering degree
  • Familiarity with computer vision pipelines, crack detection, or point cloud processing
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Installers (MSI)
  • Experience creating digitally signed application installers and collaborating with QA for deployment testing
  • Understanding REST APIs, event-driven architecture, and real-time data delivery
  • Prior experience supporting engineering or infrastructure-focused teams
  • All new hires will be required to successfully complete and pass a pre-employment (post offer) background check in compliance with NIST 800-171
  • Moffatt & Nichol uses E-Verify and employment is contingent upon the legal ability to obtain employment in the U.S. and to present the required documentation at hire

title: Testing & commissioning Engineer
description:
We are seeking an experienced Testing and commissioning Engineer to join our dynamic team for Data Center projects in Brazil. This position demands a solid foundation in electrical engineering, particularly in testing and Commissioning power generation equipment. The ideal candidate will ensure that all equipment and systems adhere to Industry standards and regulatory requirements through thorough and safe testing processes. Responsibilities will encompass managing all aspects of testing, including Factory acceptance Tests (FAT), Site acceptance Tests (Sat), and Integrated Systems Tests (IST). The engineer should be proficient in developing and executing test plans That align with customer needs while maintaining clear communication with the factory.

Key responsibilities:

  • Actual participation in testing and commissioning activities including FAT, SAT, and IST;
  • Ensure adherence to industry regulations and safety standards during testing and commissioning processes;
  • Develop and implement testing protocols to validate system functionality and performance according to customer specificity;
  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues related to testing and commissioning;
  • Collaborate with project teams to incorporate testing and commissioning activities into overall project plans;
  • Preparing project documentation, including test reports, commissioning plans, and equipment manuals;
  • Participate in project meetings and effectively communicate with stakeholders to achieve project goals.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field is preferred;
  • Proven experience in testing and commissioning power generator preferred;
  • Familiarity with industry standards and regulations related to electrical testing and commissioning (E.g., IEEE, IEC, NEC);
  • Strong troubleshooting abilities and capacity to analyze complex electrical systems;
  • Experience in project management or coordination is a plus;
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills;
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team;
  • Strong commitment to safety and quality;
  • This position may require travel to project sites or customer locations, both locally and internationally as needed.

*Please note that this is a 1 year renewable contract position*

title: CRA II or Senior CRA
description:
We are currently seeking a Clinical Research Associate to join our diverse and dynamic team. As a Clinical Research Associate at ICON, you will play a pivotal role in designing and analyzing clinical trials, interpreting complex medical data, and contributing to the advancement of innovative treatments and therapies.
What You Will Be Doing
  • Completes onsite and remote monitoring activities in accordance with all ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations, SOPs and study processes. Activities include qualifying potential investigative sites, initiating clinical trials, maintaining study files, providing instructions to site personnel and study close out.
  • Verifies the protection of study participants by confirming informed consent procedures and protocol have been performed in accordance to applicable regulations.
  • Ensures the integrity of clinical data and that the study is conducted in compliance with approved protocol, GCP, applicable regulations and SOPs.
  • Manages the investigative site staff to facilitate trial deliverables, e.g., subject enrollment, data deliverables.
  • Verifies proper management and accountability of Investigational Product (IP).
  • Writes and submits reports of investigational site findings and updates applicable tracking systems. Escalates observed deficiencies, issues, and corrective and preventative action plans as appropriate.
  • Manages essential documents as required by local regulations and ICH-GCP guidelines before, during and after a clinical study; assists with resolution of investigational site/data queries.
  • Performs key risk assessment and management responsibilities throughout the project, including key risk indicator and site health analysis, site process evaluation, and project escalation.
  • Participates in audit preparation and follow-up activities as needed.
  • Independently performs a variety of onsite and offsite monitoring visit types.
  • Gathers and reviews information for assigned siteand identifies inconsistencies. With limitedguidance from project and functional management, assesses risk and escalatesas appropriate.
  • Assists with non-complex adhoc, short-term assignmentin support of additional studies or departmental initiatives.
  • May serve as preceptor, providing training to less experienced clinical team members.
  • Undergraduate degree or international equivalent in clinical, science, or healthrelated field from an accredited institution; health care professional licensure, i.e., registered nurse
  • Previous experience supporting clinical trials including solid on-site monitoring experience in CROs or pharma companies.
  • Travel is required 50-80%.
  • All employees must read, write and speak fluent English and host country language
What ICON Can Offer You
Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.
In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well-being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family.
Visit our careers website to read more about the benefits of working at ICON:
At ICON, inclusion & belonging are fundamental to our culture and values. We’re dedicated to providing an inclusive and accessible environment for all candidates. ICON is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, or in order to perform the essential functions of a position, please let us know through the form below. Interested in the role, but unsure if you meet all of the requirements? We would encourage you to apply regardless – there’s every chance you’re exactly what we’re looking for here at ICON whether it is for this or other roles.

Fundada no interior paulista, o orgulho de nossa história de mais de 75 anos é reflexo do empenho de nossas pessoas, que imaginaram, inovaram e cresceram conosco. Hoje, nossas quatro unidades agroindustriais, localizadas em Lençóis Paulista, Macatuba, Quatá e Lucélia, junto aos nossos escritórios administrativos em Lençóis Paulista e em São Paulo, nos posicionam como uma das maiores empresas do país no setor sucroenergético.

Se você é movido(a) por desafios e quer fazer parte de um time que constrói o futuro com eficiência, impacto e responsabilidade, a Zilor é o seu lugar.

#VempraZilor

Responsabilidade:

Apoiar no desenvolvimento e acompanhamento de projetos mecânicos em indústria, atuando desde a concepção até a implementação, garantindo o atendimento das normas de qualidade e segurança industrial em busca de soluções técnicas eficazes, economicamente viáveis e sustentáveis.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia Mecânica.
  • Registro ativo no CREA.
  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência com projetos industriais.
  • Domínio em softwares de projeto (AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Plant 3D, ou similares).
  • Conhecimento avançado em dimensionamento mecânico, cálculos e checagem de tubulações industriais e especificação de materiais.
  • Vivência com normas técnicas.
  • Atuação corporativa em todas as Unidades.

Responsabilidades:

  • Garantir o desenvolvimento de projetos mecânicos industriais de médio e grande porte, incluindo levantamento de custos (budget), estudos de viabilidade, especificações técnicas e definição de escopo.
  • Elaborar e revisar projetos de equipamentos, tubulações, suportes, estruturas metálicas e sistemas térmicos e hidráulicos.
  • Elaborar calculo e verificação de bombas e sistemas de bombeamento.
  • Elaborar balanço de massa e energia de operações unitárias utilizadas nas instalações industriais com auxílio de planilhas eletrônicas ou softwares.
  • Elaborar e revisar layouts, fluxogramas (PFD/P&ID) e isométricos para instalação de equipamentos.
  • Fazer interfaces multidisciplinares com as áreas envolvidas no projeto.
  • Garantir o cumprimento de normas técnicas (ABNT, ASME, API, NR’s etc) e padrões internos da empresa.
  • Acompanhar e validar atividades de detalhamento técnico (desenhos, listas de materiais, memoriais de cálculo etc).
  • Fornecer suporte técnico durante a fase de montagem e comissionamento.
  • Atuar junto a fornecedores e contratados para definição técnica, análise de propostas e gestão técnica de contratos.
  • Apoiar o planejamento de projetos e o controle de cronograma, custo e qualidade.

Local Trabalho: Macatuba

Modalidade de Trabalho: Administrativo (segunda a sexta-feira)
